title: Open a new share (savings sub-account) for a member
description: Opens a new share account for an existing member with the given type, nickname and opening deposit, submits it (irreversible: posts the opening deposit) and returns the confirmation number.

inputs.name: share_type
inputs.description: Product type of the new share.

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: Nickname shown on statements (letters, digits, spaces; max 20).

inputs.name: opening_deposit
inputs.description: Opening deposit in USD, at least 5.00.

secrets.name: teller_username
secrets.description: Operator ID for the teller console

secrets.name: teller_password
secrets.description: Operator password for the teller console

outcomes.description: No member exists with this number.
The application rejected the share details (e.g. deposit below minimum).
The member record is restricted for this operator; supervisor override required.

provenance.goal: Sign on to the teller console, look up member {member_number}, open that member's record, start a new share account of type {share_type} with nickname {nickname} and opening deposit {opening_deposit}, continue to the review screen, submit it, and reach the transaction confirmation screen. Extract the confirmation number.
